bio: Full Stack AI Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web applications, AI-powered products with LLMs and autonomous agents, DevOps pipelines and cloud infrastructure. I love solving complex problems and creating seamless user experiences.
longBio: I'm a technologist who thrives where development meets operations. My journey started with a curiosity about how things work under the hood, which led me to explore both frontend elegance and backend robustness.

Over the years I've worked on diverse projects, from e-commerce platforms to real-time systems and agentic AI platforms. I believe in clean, maintainable code and systems that scale, combining modern development practices with DevOps principles to deliver reliable, high-performance products.
Beyond coding, I'm an advocate for continuous learning and knowledge sharing. I contribute to open-source projects and enjoy helping other developers grow.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, attending tech meetups, or working on side projects that solve real-world problems.
